cuts.head: over_shoulder
cuts.ofreeRecent: the central atrium of a space station — holds her keepsake at chest height; A brightly lit orbital market terrace — She catches a rolling orange on her tray at the end of a relaxed market lunch; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — standing with one foot up on a step; An orbital aquatic center's open sun deck under tall windows — She settles in to watch the sunrise after a swim; a wooden sauna and cold plunge with a cooling lounge — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — coils the cable of a microphone loosely around her hand; a starship galley and mess hall — standing; a small live house with a low stage — perched on a ledge or edge; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — holds a book closed against her chest; her private chamber in a Han-era residence — holds a cup at chest height; a convention photo zone under ring lights — pulls a soft wisp off a cloud of pink cotton candy on a stick; a Roman marble bath hall — sitting on the ground; a themed costume event venue with props and a photo wall — hugs a striped tub of popcorn against her side
